_README: KYLE'S EAR. The only ground truth in this project, and the scarcest.
Every judgement he has given on a SPECIFIC map file, with the words he used.
Keep the quote: 'really empty' and 'A+' are different KINDS of statement and a
later reader needs to see that, not a number we invented for them.
Tracked in docs/ on purpose — outputs/ is gitignored (see TODO C6), and losing
this would mean asking him to listen to everything again. It was previously a
hardcoded list inside scripts/preference_screen.py and, before that, prose
RULES, each of which has already cost something here:
* `better`/`worse` must name the maps he ACTUALLY PLAYED. Scoring a different
arm's map and calling it his verdict is the ExpertPlus-contamination error
* A same-song A/B (two arms, one song) is worth far more than a cross-song
comparison: cross-song forces every axis through 'gap to that song's human'
to be commensurable at all, which is the project's most repeated mistake.
* 'Can't tell' is a REAL verdict and must be recorded as one. It says the
difference is inaudible, which is evidence about the axis that claimed it.

better.name: Hunger
better.quote: The vast majority of the 1f333 song is A+ and better than what we had before so promote it.

verdicts.note: Different songs, so read every axis as a gap to THAT song's human. He may also be judging on different scales - 'A+ vs what we used to do' against 'empty vs what the song wants'. Four instruments have already failed to explain 'empty' (PROGRESS.md 2026-08-04).

verdicts.name: Hunger
verdicts.quote: Wow, I was expecting the agents song to be much better. The main problem is the notes flow in a really odd way.
verdicts.note: Kyle's vision, stated in the same breath: give the agent NOTESHEET MUSIC per instrument and vocals, and map the structure off what is actually played. The map he judged was built 2026-08-14 off brief.py's 8-bar onset-density timeline ONLY — it predates melody.py/structure.py/percussion.py (2026-08-16) and knew no pitch, no sections, no kit. Treat this as the BEFORE for the perception work, not a test of it.
verdicts.defect: FLOW — the note-to-note motion, not the note choice or the density.
verdicts.incomplete: He was still writing when the message sent; more notes may follow.
